definitions.explanation: A mathematical operation that combines two functions by sliding one over the other, widely used in signal processing and in the convolutional layers of neural networks for image recognition.

examples.japanese: {画像|がぞう}{認識|にんしき}では{畳|たた}み{込|こ}みが{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: Convolution is used in image recognition.

examples.japanese: {畳|たた}み{込|こ}みによって{特徴|とくちょう}を{抽出|ちゅうしゅつ}する。
{畳|たた}み{込|こ}みニューラルネットワークは{画像|がぞう}{処理|しょり}に{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: Convolutional neural networks are strong at image processing.

notes:
The noun form of {畳|たた}み{込|こ}む (to fold in). In mathematics and signal processing it is an operation that blends two functions; in machine learning it is the core operation of a {畳|たた}み{込|こ}みニューラルネットワーク (convolutional neural network, CNN), which slides small filters over an image to detect features.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {畳|たた}み{込|こ}み{層|そう}: convolutional layer
- {畳|たた}み{込|こ}み{演算|えんざん}: convolution operation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フィルター: filter — the small weight matrix that a convolution applies
- {行列|ぎょうれつ}: matrix — the mathematical structure convolutions operate on
